_comment: Single source of truth for the @deepseek-ai/* host packages the node test buckets need. The family is only publishable coherently through the @deepseek-ai/dsh umbrella release tree (standalone dsh-* tags drift; their cross-referenced peers can 404, e.g. dsh-compact), so ci/install-pinned.mjs materialises these via a generated standalone npm project under ci/deps/ and links the scope into the repo root. Bump '@deepseek-ai/dsh' and the 0.2.x siblings together with the newest entry of ci/compat-window.json. dsh-client-runtime is frozen upstream at 0.1.1-rc.2 (type-only surface for src/client); 0.0.1-rc.1 does not install (dep graph 404s).
unscopedComment: bare (non-@deepseek-ai) specifiers that src/tests import directly — src/index.ts dynamic-imports js-yaml, host-materialize requires it; these come hoisted from the umbrella tree and only need to be linked, not pinned (their version is governed by the dsh umbrella dependency).
conflictComment: A SECOND tree, ci/deps-conflict, deliberately NEVER linked into the repo root: tests/host-profile-isolation.mjs builds profile-shaped trees whose hoisted js-yaml is the release the umbrella does NOT carry (registry latest, while the umbrella hoists v4-legacy 4.3.2). That hostile major is the shape issue #47 measured on a real DSH Desktop profile, where a sibling plugin's dependency decided which js-yaml the bare specifier 'js-yaml' resolved to. Linking this copy into the root would flip tests/host-materialize.mjs's require('js-yaml') to 5.x and poison the development tree, so the conflict copy stays where only the arm builders can reach it.
